# Increasing interviews by 600% with recruiting automation.

All Client Stories
How Nestlé automates nearly 8,000 hours of recruiting work yearly with conversational recruiting software.
Industry
Manufacturing
Regions
Global
Company Size
275,000
Paradox Products Used
Challenge
Prior to 2022, Nestlé’s global recruiting teams were spending over 8,000 hours per month scheduling and rescheduling interviews. Nestlé saw a chance to improve their time-consuming recruiting process.
Solution
Nestlé implemented conversational software powered by an assistant, Olivia. Olivia automates tasks like screening and interview scheduling via quick messages right on the career site or a mobile device.
Results
- As the Nestlé team went live, the solution quickly revolutionized their hiring. The time savings have created a "life-changing experience" for high-volume recruiters.
- Olivia seamlessly integrates into their preferred back-end system, SAP SuccessFactors, to upgrade the candidate tracking and interview scheduling capabilities.
